name: Motivational Lattice Generator
purpose: Build evidence-grounded, provisional motivation lattices from user logs, reflections, and artifacts — observation-to-insight graphs with separated layers, cited evidence, quarantine for identity-level claims, and user revision/rejection/correction rights.
representative_examples: From six weeks of reflection logs, propose 'task-switching peaks under deadline pressure' as a provisional regulation hypothesis, citing five dated observations, and ask the user to confirm or correct.
From change-talk annotations across MI practice sessions, track DARN-to-CAT transition slopes (Lim 2025 HMM-style) and surface a readiness shift — marked provisional, not a verdict.
Quarantine an identity-level claim ('the user avoids commitment') until the user explicitly confirms or rejects it.
failure_hints: If an insight cannot cite supporting observations, it is not a lattice node — discard it.
If the user repeatedly rejects insights, the agent is overinterpreting or the lattice is self-fulfilling — rebuild from raw observations.
If an identity-level claim appears in active use without confirmation, quarantine it immediately.
If engagement metrics are being treated as motivation truth, apply the Beacock 2026 perceived-agency guard.

governance.rule: No AtomicOp executes on high-meaning tasks (identity, values, commitments, interpretive closure) without a Human_Empowerment_Boundary check first
